key.name: show-claude
key.description: Add the Claude usage indicator (one block per Claude Code profile) to the top bar.

key.name: show-codex
key.description: Add a second indicator to the top bar with the usage limits of the ChatGPT account the Codex CLI is signed in to ($CODEX_HOME/auth.json, default ~/.codex).

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Display the Claude and Codex logos in front of their indicators in the panel.

key.name: panel-gauge
key.description: Which usage gauge to draw in the panel: a circular ring, a horizontal bar, or none.

key.name: show-percentage
key.description: Display the usage percentage number in the panel.

key.name: show-tier
key.description: Display the subscription tier label in the panel.

key.name: show-reset
key.description: Display, in the panel, the time left before the window selected by panel-window resets.

key.name: show-profile-chip
key.description: Display a short two-letter tag before each profile's gauge in the panel, to tell profiles apart. Only ever shown when more than one profile is configured.

key.name: show-clock-mark
key.summary: Mark the next 8:00 or 18:00 on popup bars
key.description: Cut a small dent, labelled with the time, into each usage bar in the dropdown at the next 08:00 or 18:00 local time, whichever comes first. Nothing is drawn when the window resets before then.

key.name: pace-blue
key.description: Usage pace, in percent of the evenly spread budget, at or below which gauges are fully blue (well under budget). Between this and pace-green the colour blends from blue to green.

key.name: pace-green
key.description: Usage pace, in percent of the evenly spread budget, at which gauges are fully green (100 = exactly on schedule). The colour blends towards blue below it and towards yellow above it.

key.name: pace-yellow
key.description: Usage pace, in percent of the evenly spread budget, at which gauges are fully yellow.

key.name: pace-amber
key.description: Usage pace, in percent of the evenly spread budget, at which gauges are fully amber.

key.name: pace-red
key.description: Usage pace, in percent of the evenly spread budget, at or above which gauges are fully red. A window at 100% usage is always red.

key.name: panel-window
key.description: Which usage window the panel ring and percentage reflect: the 5-hour window, the 7-day window, the one with the highest utilization (max), or the worst active limit by severity (worst) — the latter surfaces a maxed-out per-model window such as Fable.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which section of the top bar the indicator sits in: left (next to Activities), center (by the clock), or right (the status area).

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Where the indicator sits among the other items in its panel box. 0 is the first slot; larger values move it further along. Values beyond the number of items simply place it last.

key.name: toggle-menu
key.summary: Shortcut to open the usage popup
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes the usage dropdown, the same as clicking the panel indicator. Empty means no shortcut is bound.

key.name: toggle-codex-menu
key.summary: Shortcut to open the Codex usage popup
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes the Codex usage dropdown. Empty means no shortcut is bound.

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, to poll for updated usage.

key.name: profiles
key.description: JSON array of {id, label, configDir} objects, one per Claude Code profile (a directory such as ~/.claude or ~/.claude-work holding its own .credentials.json).

key.name: profiles-initialized
key.summary: Whether the profile list has been seeded
key.description: Set once auto-detection has populated "profiles" for the first time, so a user who removes every profile afterwards isn't re-seeded.

key.name: profile-tokens
key.description: JSON object mapping a profile id to its in-app sign-in tokens ({accessToken, refreshToken, expiresAt}). Each profile signs in to its own Claude account; the older single access-token/refresh-token keys are migrated into here on first use.

key.name: access-token
key.description: Access token from the in-app sign-in, used only when Claude Code is not signed in.

key.name: refresh-token
key.description: Refresh token from the in-app sign-in, used to renew the access token.

key.name: expires-at
key.description: Millisecond timestamp when the in-app access token expires.
